title: Empires convergence: exactness bootstrap versus historical-source closure
method: Read-only comparison of immutable Git blobs. No compiler, build, sibling script, or promotion executed.

seed_quality_confound.interpretation: Imported matching source is not original game source, but it is a material head start; post-import convergence is not raw-only decompilation throughput.

claims.strong_claim: First full-file equality proves historical source closure.
claims.support: The first structural experiment recorded whole-EXE and ordered-relocation equality.
claims.counter: The same status records a nonexact ordinary candidate, 4,012 RAW ownership bytes, 4,006 local raw-source bytes, synthetic DATA/BSS, and seven adapters.
claims.confound: The equality belonged to exact_structural_experiment, not the ordinary candidate route.
claims.narrow_conclusion: It proves scoped structural construction equality only.
claims.falsifier: A clean, input-audited replay without raw/adapters reaches the recorded equality.

claims.strong_claim: Zero raw fallback proves no exact-byte representation remains.
claims.support: The raw-fallback retirement and closure states report zero under their raw metrics.
claims.counter: Closure structural status retains a 6,571-byte ASM_DB_CAPSULE category while current status decomposes the same runtime into symbolic/typed/intentional encoding categories with raw-unresolved zero.
claims.confound: The two status documents use different classification granularity.
claims.narrow_conclusion: Zero is meaningful only under a named source-quality taxonomy.
claims.falsifier: One complete taxonomy shows every active byte and no unapproved literal/capsule category.

claims.strong_claim: Convergence was monotonic after exactness appeared.
claims.support: Selected acceptance-route debt counters fall: adapters 7 to 6 to 4 to 0; final synthetic DATA/BSS are zero.
claims.counter: Ordinary candidate output remains nonexact during bootstrap, and final structural status retains a nonexact baseline diagnostic.
claims.confound: Build route and source-quality classification changed.
claims.narrow_conclusion: Only the named acceptance route has a protectable monotonic invariant.
claims.falsifier: A later acceptance-route receipt regresses SHA, relocation order, fallback, adapter, or unresolved-symbol state.

claims.strong_claim: Function-by-function C recovery was the main convergence mechanism.
claims.support: Early ownership includes many MATCHING_C owners and closure has 60 C units.
claims.counter: Exactness preceded closure of DATA/BSS/adapters; final frontier retains ASM/runtime and compiler-negative C boundaries.
claims.confound: Commit/state data do not isolate causal contribution of every change.
claims.narrow_conclusion: Route, DATA/fixup, BSS, TU/provenance, runtime and C recovery are distinct high-fanout dimensions.
claims.falsifier: A controlled replay holds these structural dimensions fixed while omitting them and still preserves acceptance.

claims.strong_claim: The convergence history measures recovery from raw code.
claims.support: The earliest repository inventory records imported correspondence/source/receipt material and fresh rebuild audit.
claims.counter: The initial inventory already contains 126 matching-C, 20 matching-ASM and 35 identified library entries; 125 C and 20 ASM entries rebuild while one stale receipt is refused.
claims.confound: Imported matching source is reconstructed rather than original source, but remains high-quality prior matching knowledge.
claims.narrow_conclusion: No post-import rate is a raw-only decompilation rate.
claims.falsifier: A raw-only baseline withholding imported correspondence/source/receipt material reaches comparable milestones under the same accounting.

high_fanout_mechanism_experiments.positive_evidence: TURNLOOP and LVLDRV require -B; BOOTSEED asm sti supplies the assembler route, while __sti__ replacement breaks exactness.
negative_controls: -B extension through HITTEST shrinks it by one byte.
No single a74a2 declaration keeps both BRDPAINT and BRDTERR exact across the proposed boundary.
HUD through ANIMFRAM is rejected because DATA is not contiguous.
high_fanout_mechanism_experiments.scope: Evidence supports a constrained grouping/route, not original lexical source text.

high_fanout_mechanism_experiments.mechanism: MUSIC code equality versus ordered relocation topology
high_fanout_mechanism_experiments.positive_evidence: A code/public-offset exact C unit on the inline-ASM/TASM route has ascending far-fixup order against historical descending order; structured C removes the route and restores descending native Turbo C order.
negative_controls: Exact code with incompatible relocation direction yields SAME_CODE_WRONG_TOPOLOGY.
No-relocation scopes are not treated as topology evidence.
high_fanout_mechanism_experiments.scope: The documented extent is 700 bytes; number of final-link bodies affected by route changes is unavailable in inspected records.

attribution.reason: No inspected source blob binds a model, configuration, prompt, or per-change authorship to recovery events. Git trailers are insufficient for that inference.

transcription_corrections.correction_method: Recomputed SHA-256 from the frozen Git blob at the listed ref; old value was 63 characters.

recommended_replay.purpose: Pre-source-closure exact structural specimen that retains visible adapter/DATA/BSS debt.

role_boundary.researcher: May inspect pinned original oracle evidence needed for reconstruction.
role_boundary.construction: Receives a frozen packet derived only from the permitted original-evidence set.
role_boundary.verifier: Separately compares constructed output with the original oracle after construction.

baseline_context.rule: Preserve declared baseline construction inputs and adapters; score their retirement separately from equality.

leak_controls: sanitized export or history-limited object store; detached worktree alone is insufficient
exclude later recovery notes, derived candidates, cached objects, generated reports and prebuilt output
reject new oracle-derived byte patches and undeclared inputs
